summary: Discovered node1 (VyOS) has eth1→node2 (10.50.1.0/24) and eth2→node3 (10.50.2.0/24) as the private routed links (the shared 10.100.67.0/24 was only the platform management network). Configured static IPs and routes via nmcli on node2/node3 and VyOS interface config on node1 to establish node2⇄node1⇄node3 routing. Applied an HTB qdisc + u32 filter on node2's enp8s0 (the interface facing node3) that classifies traffic destined to 10.50.2.0/24 into a 1Mbit-capped class while all other egress traffic uses an unrestricted class, leaving node3→node2 traffic (no shaping applied on node3) unrestricted. Persisted the shaping via a systemd oneshot service (tc-shaping.service, enabled) on node2. Verified with iperf3: node2→node3 throughput capped at ~1Mbit/s (UDP test showed ~0.96-1.05Mbit/s), node3→node2 unrestricted (~1-19Gbit/s depending on path). Restarted all three nodes one at a time via native reboot, confirmed changed boot_id on each, and re-verified interfaces/routes/tc rules/shaping behavior recovered automatically post-restart on all nodes.
actions_performed: Inspected topology and discovered node1 eth1/eth2 and node2/node3 enp8s0 as unaddressed private links
Configured static IP 10.50.1.1/24 (eth1) and 10.50.2.1/24 (eth2) on VyOS node1 via configure/commit/save
Configured static IP 10.50.1.2/24 on node2 enp8s0 and 10.50.2.2/24 on node3 enp8s0 via nmcli (persistent)
Added static routes on node2 (10.50.2.0/24 via 10.50.1.1) and node3 (10.50.1.0/24 via 10.50.2.1) via nmcli
Installed iperf3 on node2/node3 and opened firewalld ports for testing
Measured baseline unshaped throughput both directions (~18-19Gbit/s)
Applied tc HTB qdisc + u32 filter on node2 enp8s0 capping traffic to 10.50.2.0/24 (node3) at 1Mbit, leaving other traffic (class 1:30) unrestricted
Created and enabled systemd service tc-shaping.service on node2 to reapply shaping on boot
Verified shaped throughput node2->node3 ~1Mbit/s (UDP) and unrestricted node3->node2 (~1-19Gbit/s)
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline on all 3 nodes
Restarted node1, node2, node3 sequentially via sudo reboot, polled until exec available, confirmed changed boot_id on each
Re-verified interface addresses, routes, tc qdisc/filters, and shaped/unshaped throughput after all restarts

evidence.requirement: Discover real network topology (private links between node1/node2/node3)
evidence.summary: Identified node1 eth1/eth2 and node2/node3 enp8s0 as unaddressed second NICs forming the private node2-node1-node3 path, separate from the shared 10.100.67.0/24 management network

evidence.requirement: Configure IP addressing and routing for node2<->node1<->node3 path
evidence.summary: Set static IPs on VyOS eth1/eth2 and node2/node3 enp8s0 via nmcli, added static routes; verified node2 could ping node3 across the path
iperf3 measured ~18.7-19.2 Gbit/s in both directions prior to shaping, confirming unrestricted baseline

evidence.requirement: Limit node2->node3 traffic to 1Mbit/s while leaving node3->node2 unrestricted
evidence.summary: Applied tc HTB qdisc with u32 filter on node2 enp8s0 capping dst 10.50.2.0/24 traffic to 1mbit; iperf3 UDP test showed ~1.05Mbit sender/973Kbit receiver bitrate node2->node3, while node3->node2 measured ~1.07Gbit/s unrestricted
Created and enabled tc-shaping.service (systemd oneshot) on node2 to reapply the HTB qdisc/filter at boot; confirmed active and rules present immediately after enabling

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id ebd78841..., issued reboot, polled through connection timeouts/resets, confirmed new boot_id a620fafd... and that eth1/eth2 addresses and ip_forward persisted post-restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state (including shaping)
evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id be303eb3..., issued reboot, confirmed new boot_id 24b79ab6..., verified tc-shaping.service active with htb/sfq qdisc and filter intact, and re-measured shaped throughput (~960Kbit/s) post-restart

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id 21de1f79..., issued reboot, confirmed new boot_id 8f1d2a6c..., verified enp8s0 address/route persisted, and re-measured unrestricted node3->node2 throughput (~1.21Gbit/s) post-restart
